Talent0_2Ability.name: Iron-blooded Commander
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: Can use command skill <skill mainSkill=301350>[Marshall Edict]</skill>. When initiating combat with a Sniper Rifle, triggers <color=#F74848>2</color> <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>25%</color> original DMG each.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Iron-blooded Commander
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects: Can use command skill <skill mainSkill=301350>[Marshall Edict]</skill>. When initiating combat with a Sniper Rifle, triggers <color=#F74848>3</color> <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>30%</color> original DMG each.

300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: After destroying the target, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

301302.name: Pincer Tactics
301302.SpecificEffects: After initiating combat, <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> launches a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> on the same target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.3x</color>. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. This <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> does not require allies to possess a specific skill and does not consume any Link times.

301303.name: Disrupting Shot
301303.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. Upon <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> hitting an enemy, deals <color=#F74848>75%</color> Splash DMG to parts other than the part hit.

301304.name: Charisma
301304.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> gains command skill <skill mainSkill=301304>[Servitude]</skill>

301305.name: Wise Leader
301305.SpecificEffects: Reduces <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> chance to be critically hit by <color=#F74848>15%</color>. When traversing within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles of <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf>, movement cost is reduced by <color=#F74848>50%</color>.

301306.name: Blood Oath
301306.describe: Selects an empty tile within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles, teleports <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> to that tile and grants <buf ID=3013061>[Loyalty]</buf> to them. Can continue to act with remaining movement.

301307.name: Strategic General
301307.SpecificEffects: Critical Hit chance increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>. During <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf>, Critical Hit chance additionally increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

301308.name: Extermination Order
301308.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.4x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> count increases by <color=#F74848>+2</color>. If <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> is within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles of [Audrey], this attack and <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> ignores target's <buf ID=900160>[DMG Reduction]</buf> effect.

hiddenSkills.name: Landslide Shot
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2
300011.SpecificEffects: [Sniper Warfare 1] can trigger after destroying a part.

300021.name: Sniper Warfare 3
300021.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering [Sniper Warfare 1]'s <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, can move <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

300022.name: Power Innovation 2
300022.SpecificEffects: When destroying a part, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

301231.name: Hunter's Mark 1
301231.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with a Ranged Weapon and destroying a part, gains different <buf ID=900141>[Hunter's Boon]</buf> effects based on the part type. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301234.name: Hunter's Mark 2
301234.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with a Ranged Weapon, if the target is destroyed, can move an extra <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles.

301235.name: Hunter's Mark 3
301235.SpecificEffects: [Hunter's Mark 1] can now trigger an unlimited number of times per turn.

301236.name: Hunter's Mark 4
301236.SpecificEffects: At start of action, randomly gains <color=#F74848>1</color> unacquired <buf ID=900141>[Hunter's Boon]</buf> effect.

301341.name: Conqueror Will 1
301341.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> is triggered <color=#F74848>2</color> times or more, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allowing movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300043.name: Power Innovation 3
300043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301344.name: Conqueror Will 2
301344.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> prioritizes hitting the same part as the first attack.

301345.name: Conqueror Will 3
301345.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Sniper Rifle, DMG dealt and Hit Rate are increased by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

301346.name: Conqueror Will 4
301346.SpecificEffects: While <buf ID=3013504>[Personal Aide]</buf> is present, Sniper Rifle range increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color> and <buf ID=900148>[Ricochet]</buf> count increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
